# FLX-7101: a candidate of the fit could not be run

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

Each evaluation of a fit applies the candidate values to a copy of the bundle, plans and applies it at the calibration's scale, and counts the calibration queries on the run. When that run was refused (a candidate outside what the bundle accepts, or a run that failed) the fit stops: the message names the evaluation and the refusal. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7101
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
